hints.title: Digit Rotation Rules
hints.text: Inspect each number to verify that every digit remains valid when rotated and at least one digit changes.

hints.title: Classification of Digits
hints.text: Digits 0, 1, 8 map to themselves; digits 2, 5, 6, 9 rotate to valid different digits; digits 3, 4, 7 become invalid.

hints.title: Validation Criteria
hints.text: A number is valid if it contains only 0, 1, 8, 2, 5, 6, 9 and contains at least one of 2, 5, 6, 9.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Iterates through 1 to N checking digit membership in valid sets.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rotating full numbers as strings without set categorization leads to redundant conversion operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant lookup tables use O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Classify digits into invalid {3,4,7}, neutral {0,1,8}, and mutating {2,5,6,9}.
